text: Chapter 12: The Weredragons' Vital Point@Weredragon Couple and a Baby
■Next Mission\nStart from Boma Moja: Village Center.
The weredragons who are moving the Movere forest might know\nhow to get to the vital point of the weredragons.\nHead to Nebula Plain to get to the cockpit!
Head to the freight forridor that leads to the cockpit!
Dragon minions have entered the freight corridor and\nthey are ravaging the goods. Beat them!
Take the weredragon couple who got lost in the\nfreight corridor with you and head to the Operation Zone\nwhere the cockpit is!
Go to the next area after listening to the explanation about\nthe propulsion system of the Movere forest from the\n3 homunculi you met at the Power Control Area!
Head to the next area while beating the dragons that have\nentered the residential area of the weredragons moving\nthe Movere forest!
The wall in the Climate Control Area is broken resulting in\nmore dragons coming in. Beat them and head straight to the\ncockpit!
The baby held by the weredragon couple turns out to be\nTrickster Dragon Mimyugon. Defeat Mimyugon to protect the\ncockpit!
[[N]]Go to Operation Zone: Climate Control Area
